description: Gives a client access to team workouts and programs so they show up in their app. Use when the user wants to assign, share or send a workout or program to a specific client. Not for publishing to every member (set visibility on the workout or program instead). Returns what was assigned. Sends the client an email and a push notification for each item.

client_id.description: ID of the client (their user ID). Get it from list_clients (the "id" of each client), e.g. "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1".

program_ids.description: IDs of programs to give the client, up to 50. Get them from list_team_programs.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

workout_ids.description: IDs of workouts to give the client, up to 50. Get them from list_team_workouts.

name: assign_content_to_client
title: Assign content to client
